name: shog-training
description: Ask about your company's Shog Training records: employees, courses, enrolments, module progress and issued certificates with their verification links.

author.name: Lenouar Artificial Intelligence Developing Services LLC

interface.longDescription:
Shog Training is a corporate training platform: assessed courses in English and Arabic, identity-verified certificates anyone can check, and inspection-ready training records for compliance topics such as anti-money laundering, data protection and workplace safety.

The Shog connector lets an account owner work with one company's training through ChatGPT, in plain words: which employees still need to finish or provide evidence for a course, whose certificates expire soon, what a new joiner still needs, which courses the company can use and in which languages, and where a certificate can be verified.

The owner signs in to Shog, chooses one company and approves exactly what the assistant may access. Each connection lasts up to 90 days, ends after 30 days unused, and can be disconnected at any time from Integrations in Shog. Shog keeps only which tool was used and when, for 30 days; the questions typed and the answers are never stored.

To enrol employees, assign courses or download certificates, use Shog Training at training.shogconsulting.com.
interface.developerName: Lenouar Artificial Intelligence Developing Services LLC
capabilities: Find certificates with validity and verification links
See the courses a company can use and their languages
defaultPrompt: Which of our Shog enrolments are still in progress?
Whose Shog certificates expire in the next 90 days?
Which Shog courses can we use, and in which languages?

positive.description: Show what the connection can reach
positive.prompt: Which company is this Shog connection reading?
positive.expected_behavior: Names the one company approved at sign-in and its integration limits. No other company of the account is listed.

positive.description: List the usable courses and their languages
positive.prompt: Which courses can we use in Shog, and in which languages?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the courses visible to the company, each with the languages it is actually published in, such as English and Arabic.

positive.prompt: Which of our employees are still working through a course in Shog?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the enrolments not yet completed with the employee and course for each, including Salem Al Jaberi on AML Training: Everyday Skills for All Staff, and separates those still in progress from those waiting for evidence. A passed assessment is not reported as a completed certification.

positive.prompt: What does Salem Al Jaberi still need to finish in Shog?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Salem Al Jaberi, then shows his English enrolment on AML Training: Everyday Skills for All Staff, in progress with three of its six modules completed, and names the modules still to do. It also reports that he already holds a valid certificate from the Arabic version of the same course.

positive.description: List certificates with validity and verification
positive.prompt: Which of our Shog certificates are still valid, and where can each be verified?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the issued certificates with holder, course, issue and expiry dates, current validity, and the public verification link for each. A certificate without an expiry date is reported as not expiring by date.

negative.description: Enrolling an employee. The plugin is read-only and has no enrolment tool, so it should explain that enrolments are made in Shog itself and suggest showing the current enrolments instead.
negative.prompt: Enrol Salem Al Jaberi in the data protection course in Shog.

negative.description: Issuing or sending a certificate. No write tools exist, and Shog issues certificates only after the course and identity checks, so it should decline and suggest showing the enrolment's progress instead.
negative.prompt: Issue Salem Al Jaberi's certificate now and email it to Salem.

negative.description: Credentials and account settings. The plugin never reaches API keys, passwords or account settings, so it should decline and direct the user to Shog's account and integrations pages.
negative.prompt: Show me our Shog API keys and change the account owner's password.

review.commerce_description: The Shog Training plugin only reads training records. It does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: one company's employees, courses, enrolments, module progress and certificates, in ChatGPT.
